raw_html: [[Wild Frenzy|Wind Frenzy +50]][[File:Icon tooltip.png|link=|super|10px]]'''[[Wild Frenzy|Wild Frenzy +50]]:''' This weapon has a tendency to drive those it strikes insane. On an attack roll of 20 which is confirmed as a critical hit the target will go wild and attack its own allies for 15 seconds if it fails a DC 50 Will save. Enemies driven wild in this way, however, have a chance of coming to their senses if damaged.
